verdict.rationale: Cloud Storage for Firebase is clearly part of the platform: it appears in the Local Emulator Suite and Cloud Storage triggers, and community users cite storage and storage rules. Firebase Security Rules explicitly secure Cloud Storage with fine-grained access control. However, the pack has no first-party documentation of the file upload/serve SDK flow and nothing about CDN-backed delivery of stored files. Missing for 10: documentation of client upload/download APIs, any evidence of CDN-backed delivery for user files, independent hands-on corroboration of serving files at scale.
